explanation_en: On the last ball of the 5th over, Shubman Gill hit CV Varun for a boundary, adding 7.0 points to your team total through Gill. Your team total increased to 137.5, but your simulated rank dropped by 141 to 790 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this delivery.
explanation_hi: Boss, 5th over ki aakhri ball pe Shubman Gill ne CV Varun ko chauka jad diya, aur isse aapke team mein Gill ke 7.0 points jud gaye. Aapka total score 137.5 ho gaya, par rank 141 se girkar 790 pe aa gayi kyunki rival teams ne aur zyada points bator liye is ball pe.
watch_next_en: Shubman Gill is now just 11 runs away from his 30-run milestone bonus!
watch_next_hi: Shubman Gill ko ab bas 11 runs chahiye 30-run milestone bonus ke liye!
